source.citation: Alzubaidi, Fatimah (2021), Lithology dataset, Mendeley Data, V1, doi:10.17632/b6rj29mrss.1.
source.labelMethod: Paper section 2.2 reports labels based on trained geologists’ lithology logs and manual checking of the final crops. These published classes are not a new GeoModel3D geologist review.
source.mirrorCredit: Breejesh Dhar, Automated Lithology Classification, Kaggle, version 1 (2023).
source.sourcePhotographsCredit: Geological Survey of South Australia; see Alzubaidi dataset and paper.
source.rawBytesChanges: None. Copied unchanged from the public mirror archive.
source.derivedImageChanges: Benchmark PNG inputs are derived for this pilot; see benchmark protocol for exact transformations and per-input hashes.

sampling.algorithm: Ascending SHA256(UTF8(seed + NUL + archive path)); first 2 paths per test class

limitations: Published lithology reference labels; no new human geologist review by this project.
Already cropped 2 x 2 cm patches; no claim of matched whole-row versus crop improvement.
Folder test split is not demonstrated borehole/site-held-out; unknown pretraining overlap.
No fracture, RQD, rock strength, depth interval, or engineering-property ground truth.
